answer_1.quote: we explore leveraging LLMs to effectively transform toxic inputs into harmless yet semantically equivalent outputs.

answer_2.quote: we use the following evaluation metrics to assess detoxification performance: • Style Accuracy (STA) ... • Semantic Similarity (SIM) ... • Fluency (FL) ... • Joint Score (J)

answer_4.quote: we sampled 100 instances from each dataset and compared our method against the best-performing baseline on that dataset. We adopted a win-rate comparison approach. For each sampled instance, we presented the original input, our detoxified output, and the baseline's detoxified output to human annotators.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were asked to decide which output was better, or to indicate a tie.
